title: Dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane Impairs Amyloid Beta Clearance by Decreasing Liver X Receptor alpha Expression.
authors: Wu, Dongmei; Hu, Yang; Song, Min; Li, Gongbo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DDT通过LXRalpha影响Abeta清除，涉及LXRalpha（转录因子）与配体互作的分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是环境毒理而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: Abnormal amyloid beta (Abeta) clearance is a distinctive pathological mechanism for Alzheimer's disease (AD). ATP-binding cassette transporter A1 (ABCA1), which mediates the lipidation of apolipoprotein E, plays a critical role in Abeta clearance. As an environmental factor for AD, dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT) can decrease ATP-binding cassette transporter A1 (ABCA1) expression and disrupt Abeta clearance. Liver X receptor alpha (LXRalpha) is an autoregulatory transcription factor for ABCA1 and a target of some environmental pollutants, such as organophosphate pesticides. In this study, we aimed to investigate whether DDT could affect Abeta clearance by targeting LXRalpha. The DDT-pretreated H4 human neuroglioma cells and immortalized astrocytes were incubated with exogenous Abeta to evaluate Abeta consumption. Meanwhile, cytotoxicity and LXRalpha expression were determined in the DDT-treated cells. Subsequently, the antagonism of DDT on LXRalpha agonist T0901317 was determined in vitro. The interaction between DDT and LXRalpha was predicted by molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation technology. We observed that DDT could inhibit Abeta clearance and decrease the levels of LXRalpha mRNA and LXRalpha protein. Moreover, DDT is supposed to strongly bind to LXRalpha and exert antagonistic effects on LXRalpha. In conclusion, this study firstly presented that DDT could inhibit LXRalpha expression, which would contribute to Abeta clearance decline in vitro. It provides an experimental basis to search for potential therapeutic targets of AD.
abstract_zh: 异常淀粉样β蛋白（Abeta）清除是阿尔茨海默病（AD）的一种独特病理机制。ATP结合盒转运体A1（ABCA1）介导载脂蛋白E的脂化，在Abeta清除中发挥关键作用。作为AD的环境因素，二氯二苯三氯乙烷（DDT）可降低ATP结合盒转运体A1（ABCA1）表达并破坏Abeta清除。肝X受体α（LXRalpha）是ABCA1的自调控转录因子，也是某些环境污染物（如有机磷农药）的靶点。本研究旨在探讨DDT是否通过靶向LXRalpha影响Abeta清除。将DDT预处理的H4人神经胶质瘤细胞和永生化星形胶质细胞与外源性Abeta共孵育，以评估Abeta消耗情况。同时，测定DDT处理细胞的细胞毒性和LXRalpha表达。随后，在体外测定DDT对LXRalpha激动剂T0901317的拮抗作用。通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟技术预测DDT与LXRalpha之间的相互作用。我们观察到DDT能抑制Abeta清除，并降低LXRalpha mRNA和LXRalpha蛋白水平。此外，DDT被认为能强效结合LXRalpha，并对LXRalpha产生拮抗效应。总之，本研究首次表明DDT能抑制LXRalpha表达，这可能有助于体外Abeta清除下降。这为寻找AD潜在治疗靶点提供了实验基础。
